summary: German CP template of Clinic F with a letterhead cover page, a summary part ending in a signature block, and a long appendix. Compared with T11 it adds alpha peak frequency, an asymmetry index and a workload index, and its table of contents is typed out with page numbers. The appendix covers questionnaires, cognitive tests, VCPT, spectra, indices, ERPs, microstates, classifiers, HRV and treatment texts.
